payload.reason: The evidence provides a detailed explanation of how the BERT-based model works for extractive query-focused summarization, including input representation, sentence selection, and training methodology.

claims.text: The BERT-based model encodes query relevance and document context into vector representations using BERT, which are then used to predict sentence labels or scores.
The model takes the concatenation of the query and document as input, modeling relationships through a self-attention mechanism.
Input representations are constructed using token, segmentation, and position embeddings, with special tokens indicating sentence boundaries.
The model is fine-tuned on the WikiRef dataset and DUC datasets to improve performance and reduce redundancy in the output summary.
